title: Doppia
lede: A curated corpus of musical scores, annotated fragment by fragment and linked to a knowledge graph of the concepts behind them.

glossary.title: The glossary
glossary.body: Every concept has a page: what it is, where it sits among its neighbours, and annotated examples you can play.

fragments.title: Browse fragments
fragments.body: Pick a concept and read the passages tagged with it, in notation, with their analysis alongside.

corpus.title: The corpus
corpus.body: Scores by composer and work, for reading whole movements and for tagging.

note: Doppia is being built in the open, and the corpus is still growing.
